Commentary of Sayyid Qutb (Fi Zilal al-Quran, Urdu translation) on surah 41, verse 53:

After this, the Qur'an now leaves them to their own condition, so that they may reflect. Then it turns attention to this vast universe, saying: Behold, Allah has fixed within it signs and decrees whose manifestation will occur in the future.

This is the final blow and the final comment... Allah promises His servants that soon you will be informed of some of the secrets of this universe. Likewise, revelations will be made to you concerning the secrets within your own self and being; that is, the signs of the inner selves and the horizons will be shown to you. And when these secrets are unveiled... it will become known that this Book is a true Book. This Book, this method and this system of life, and this word that is being told to you, are all true.

In truth, Allah's promise was true. For the past fourteen hundred years, Allah has manifested many signs of the inner selves and the horizons to humankind, and this process continues. Strange and wonderful revelations have occurred concerning the human self, and also concerning the universe.

Then humanity too has remained engaged, and since the revelation of the Qur'an until today, it has made many discoveries. The vastness of this universe has been seen far and wide by humanity, and it has been opened up to them, and the resources of the human soul have also become clear to it, and this process will continue indefinitely.

Humanity has learned and seen much. If humanity would investigate how it came to perceive these things, and would give thanks to Allah, that would be better for it.

For example, humanity has discovered that the earth, which it had considered the centre of the universe, is in fact a insignificant speck that is subject to the sun. And they have discovered that this sun is a small sphere in this universe, and that there are several hundred million suns like it. They have understood the reality of the sun, moon, earth and heavens, and they have also understood the reality of their own existence and self.

Then humanity has also identified most of the elements within the matter of this universe, that is, what components exist within this matter, if it is correct to say that there is matter. Then humanity saw that the fundamental matter of this universe is the particle. They also discovered that this particle takes on the form of radiation. Thus they saw that in reality this whole universe is light: light of various kinds, from which things of various forms and shapes are made.

Scientists have learned a great deal about this small sphere and the earth, that it is a ball and resembles a ball. They have also determined that it rotates on its own axis and revolves around the sun. They have mapped its continents, its seas and its rivers. They have penetrated into its interior, and have seen what was hidden in its belly, what forces are deposited within it, and then which of those forces exist in the atmosphere.

They have also determined that the natural law that has bound their earth together with this entire universe is a single law. Transformations occur in this universe, and humanity has discovered most of them. Now, among humanity there are some people of knowledge who, from these laws, have come to know that there is a Creator, and there are some for whom this very world became a ruin. They became lost within these apparent discoveries and could not advance further. But after this great unveiling of the signs of Allah, humanity has now begun to turn back to Allah and has begun to acknowledge that this is the truth.

The conquests of knowledge within the human being and within the human self are no less than those of this universe. Humanity has learned much about the human body, its composition, its characteristics, and its secrets and subtleties. It has gathered extensive knowledge about its structure, its organs and their functions, its diseases, and its nourishment, and it has also learned much about human actions and movements. All these discoveries are in fact concerning the signs of Allah. No one other than Him is the Creator of these things.

Humanity has also learned much about human psychology. Although this is not to the extent of the signs of the body that humanity has discovered, because human striving has been focused mostly on the human body and its instrumental status, the human intellect and its soul have not yet received much attention. Yet in the field of the human self, certain things have been revealed, and they indicate that in this field too there will be great conquests in the future, and humanity will see further signs. For now, humanity is still on the road.

Allah's promise stands.

"Soon We shall show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth" (41:53). And the final part of this promise, that the Qur'an is the Book of truth, has begun to show its effects in the twentieth century. Caravans of faith are gathering from different paths, so that even through the path of purely material sciences people are advancing towards the truth of Islam. From every side, the armies of Islam are assembling. Although the waves of materialism and atheism that rose on this earth in the past were very rebellious, this storm is coming to an end. Although the opposing wind was very fierce, I can say that before this century through which we are passing ends, these storms of materialism and atheism will end, and the word of Allah will prevail. (O Sayyid Qutb! May Allah inform your spirit that the atheist Soviet Union has ended, the one whose dog-like agents made you attain the rank of martyrdom. And while materialism and American atheism were being fought against by divine armies, it is hoped that they too will end very soon. Translator.)

"Is it not sufficient that your Lord is a witness over all things?" (41:53). Allah has made this promise with knowledge and certainty. He sees, and He is surely just, and therefore it is true.

Commentary of Sayyid Qutb (Fi Zilal al-Quran, Urdu translation) on surah 41, verse 54:

Alā innahum fī miryatin min liqā'i rabbihim (41:54): "Be aware, these people are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord." This is the reason they commit these mistakes, because they do not have full certainty about meeting Allah. This is a matter of the strongest emphasis.

Alā innahu bikulli shay'in muhīt (41:54): "Be aware, He encompasses everything." Therefore, how can you escape from meeting Him? You are completely within His encirclement.
